payload.title: R9: Coach and warm-up button text in plain English (STE chrome) (S)
payload.description:
Effort: S. Do first.

**Problem.** UI chrome breaks the project's own STE rule (no contractions).
**Evidence.** CoachPanel.tsx and WarmupCard.tsx: 'Let's watch', 'Let's see why', 'I'm fine', 'Want a nudge?', 'Got it', 'Skip the tour?'; docs/lesson-format.md requires no contractions. Empty box shows '–' but lesson 5 says 'starts at 0'.
**Change.** 'Watch why', 'I am fine', 'Do you want a hint?', 'Close'; show an empty box as 0 or say 'empty' everywhere; extend the STE check to UI strings in web/src.
**Acceptance.**
- Given web/src chrome strings, then the STE check finds no contractions.
- The empty box reads the same in every lesson.
